blockers.details: Protected-area rules: apply Skuleskogen, Skuleberget, Balesudden, Hörnsjön rules only to affected portions recorded in packets/caveat file.

DinTur available through Trafiklab APIs but require API key; DinTur/Fskab planner stop-area IDs and WGS84 coords are research-grade, not final national IDs. Replace with Trafiklab/ResRobot before automated transit import if key available.
Slåttdalsskrevan, Hörnsjön notice, fire-ban status, transit, seasonal boats, and service opening/currentness require recheck before publication.
Pending/suppressed facility items must remain out of public normalized facilities until verified.

openDecisions.decision: Use Höga Kusten 26.8 km while preserving Naturkartan/GPX contradictions metadata.
Prefer conservative Naturkartan red/krävande while preserving Höga Kusten Medel caveat.
Suppress Nationalparksbussen/Världsarvsbussen 2026 unless new official timetable appears.
Model seasonal boats as optional seasonal onward/side access only, not required trail crossings.

validationChecklist: No runtime app data, generated public data, shared scripts, or package files changed.
All 9 current section files are represented in sectionCoverage.
Section 2 distance display caveat is carried into geometryPlan.
Section 7 difficulty and Slåttdalsskrevan warning are carried into geometryPlan/ruleWarningPlan.
Protected-area rule applications are limited to recorded affected portions.
Transit ID limitations and 2026 shuttle suppression remain explicit.
Pending/suppressed facilities remain out of public normalized facilities until verified.
